title: 前高盛策略师艾比·约瑟夫·科恩：格林斯潘的两件趣事
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: What did you say to the graduate students this week about Alan Greenspan?
segments.zh: 这周你对研究生们说了什么关于艾伦·格林斯潘？

segments.en: Well, first of all, Tom and Lisa, I'm delighted to be here with you today.
segments.zh: 首先，汤姆和丽莎，很高兴今天能和你们在一起。

segments.en: There's so much to say about Alan Greenspan, and so much has already been said.
segments.zh: 关于艾伦·格林斯潘，有太多可说的，而且已经说了很多。

segments.en: There were two personal episodes that I had with Alan, and both of them left me smiling when I thought about it. And let me discuss the first one, which is the more recent one.
segments.zh: 我和艾伦有过两次个人接触，每次回想起来都让我微笑。先说最近的一次。

segments.en: Not that long ago, just a handful of years ago, Alan published a book that he had co-written with Alan Woodridge rather from the economist about capitalism in the United States.
segments.zh: 不久前，也就是几年前，艾伦出版了一本与《经济学人》的艾伦·伍德里奇合著的书，关于美国的资本主义。

segments.en: And it was so incredibly sharp. They asked me to moderate the panel and the discussion with him
segments.zh: 这本书非常犀利。他们让我主持小组讨论，与他的对话紧扣主题。

segments.en: at that point was right on on topic. And to your point, one of his concerns had to do with budget deficits and also social security. I look at Alan Woodridge's work with our editor-in-chief
segments.zh: 当时，他关注的问题包括预算赤字和社会保障。我看艾伦·伍德里奇与主编约翰·米克尔思韦特的工作，那是一个历史框架。

segments.en: John Mikkelthwaite, and it is that historical construct. The Greenspan critics will say he got wrong regulation. Did you perceive that while sitting at Goldman Sachs? When I met with Alan and
segments.zh: 格林斯潘的批评者会说他在监管上犯了错。你在高盛时是否察觉到了？当我与艾伦和FOMC其他成员会面时，我确实谈到了监管方面。

segments.en: other members of the FOMC, I did talk about the regulatory aspect. And the thing that was interesting to me is that they were well aware of some of the problems that were developing
segments.zh: 有趣的是，他们很清楚正在出现的一些问题，比如住房市场和次级信贷市场。

segments.en: in the housing market, for example, and in the subprime credit market. And that was his biggest
